worldcombat.skill.roost.summary: Folds its wings and settles to the ground, then rests there: the healing is paid out in several portions for about half of maximum health. While resting it loses the Flying type and lies open to ground moves and Grassy Terrain; clearing the identity cuts the remaining portions.
worldcombat.skill.roost.use.0: Portion a heal out between blows
worldcombat.skill.roost.use.1: Trade a grounded window for a steadier restore
worldcombat.skill.roost.use.2: Bring a flier down to the ground and the terrain
worldcombat.skill.roost.description.0: Rests on the ground for %2$s and restores %1$s of maximum health in portions; while resting it loses the Flying type and lies open to ground moves and Grassy Terrain.
worldcombat.skill.roost.description.2: Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s, driven by Speed and weight.
worldcombat.skill.roost.stance.deep: Deep roost: a little more healing and a 1.5x resting window, at the cost of a longer cooldown and a longer grounded window - for a safe moment.
worldcombat.skill.roost.stance.shallow: Shallow roost: quicker to settle and a shorter cooldown, with slightly less healing and less time on the ground - for a gap between blows.
worldcombat.skill.roost.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.roost.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.roost.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
On: +0.06 healing and a 1.5x resting window, but a longer cooldown and a longer grounded window. Off (shallow): quicker to settle and a shorter cooldown, with slightly less healing.
worldcombat.skill.roost.preference.ai.he: The companion roosts below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher roosts at the first wound.
